correctness.rationale: For the periodic solution, write each demeaned output as η(A cos(ωt)+B sin(ωt)). Its orientation is the sign of the determinant A_q B_c−B_q A_c, with positive ∮Q dC counterclockwise; the integral is πη² times that determinant. Expanding by pathway pairs gives πη²ω N_c(ω²)/D(ω²), with D positive and deg N_c≤m−2. As an independent rigidity check, put s_j=−1/τ_j² and D_j=∏_{i≠j}(1−τ_i²/τ_j²). Then N_c(s_j)/(τ_j² D_j q_j)=Σ_{i≠j} q_i(c_j/q_j−c_i/q_i)/(τ_j+τ_i). If N_c is zero, evaluate at a maximal c_j/q_j: positivity of all coefficients forces every ratio equal. Thus rank is m−1, and c=q+εv stays positive for sufficiently small ε>0 for any numerator preimage v. Taking a polynomial with prescribed simple positive squared-frequency roots makes every designated root a reversal and exhausts them. Proportional weights give zero area at all frequencies; with m=2 a nonproportional pair has nonzero constant numerator and no reversal. Pairwise arithmetic gives the stated three-pathway coefficients (−3/4,21/2); on common denominator 3800 the four-pathway coefficients are (3800,−9500,3800). The result needs fixed common sinusoidal forcing, periodic steady state, and these affine linear response observables; it does not identify field pathways.
